abstract: Cloudways is fast, steady managed cloud hosting for established WordPress sites. Independent tests measured 99.996% to 99.999% uptime. The 80% Black Friday offer saves about 13% over the first year.

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes for established WordPress sites. Hostingstep measured 99.996% to 99.999% uptime across five plans, and Finding the Universe rated it 4.5 out of 5 after six years.
It is easier than running your own server, but harder than basic shared hosting. Several reviews mention a learning curve.
A fast server helps visitors and crawling. Hostingstep measured response times of 419 to 447 ms, but content and links still decide rankings.
Flexible plans on DigitalOcean start at $14 a month at list price. Autonomous plans start at $99 a month. AI Agents plans start at $9.99 a month.

mainEntity.name: Does Cloudways have a free trial?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. It lists a 5-day free trial on Flexible plans with no card needed, and a 3-day trial on Autonomous plans.

mainEntity.name: What is the Cloudways Black Friday offer?

acceptedAnswer.text: 80% off for 2 months on all plans, with code BFCM802 shown on the pricing page. The page we read shows no end date.
Not in the headline price. Hostingstep and DevOpsCube both list email as an extra or a missing feature.
Finding the Universe says backups are not included in the headline price. Check the backup price before you buy.
Yes on Medium or larger plans. Hostingstep found DigitalOcean plans completed every request in its load test.
DigitalOcean plans finished every request in Hostingstep's load test. Vultr High Frequency and Linode scored higher on computing power but dropped some requests at peak.
Yes. It lists Cloudways Copilot, AI Agents plans and an MCP server. We found no independent test of them.
Owners of tiny sites on a tight budget, people who want email in the same account, and power users who want full control of every layer.
